coder_notes: Pan-solid-tumour IDH1/IDH2-mutant phase 1. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords; conditions list Glioma, eligibility needs an IDH1 R132 (or IDH2) mutation, so I coded not_glioblastoma (also IDH-mutant only). Role of durvalumab and gemcitabine/cisplatin is debatable (cohort-specific partners; coded soc_backbone since LY3410738 is the single investigational agent). Regimen coded combination because expansion cohorts 4 and 5 add partners; escalation and cohorts 1-3 are monotherapy.
